docs.title: Cache Typed Value with TTL
docs.description: Legacy and V2 scalar scoped block with no block parameters. Lazy iOS27 Stored Content cache for source-typed Text, Number, Bool and Date. Date uses an epoch-offset archive with exact native reconstruction guards; its original object is returned on a miss. The body must return one supported value; Void and unqualified complex/native objects are rejected. Literal key/ttl/scope; ttl0 bypasses storage. Versioned scalar envelope, post-body expiry, clock rollback and changed-policy misses. Sensitive values require explicit opt-in. Dictionary/List/Optional/JsonNull/File, atomic compare-and-set and recoverable native parser/storage errors are not supported; native cache acceptance remains pending.

docs.title: Assert Condition
docs.description: Stop the Shortcut with a message when the condition is false.

docs.title: Clear Debug Logs
docs.description: Reset the execution-local debug log to an empty value.

docs.title: Export Local Debug File
docs.description: Return one local JSON/text artifact without saving, sharing or uploading. Payloads remain fully redacted by default. Explicit redactSensitive:false exports Text, native Number display text, ISO 8601 Dates and bounded Dictionary field diagnostics. Source Bool, null and List boundaries are not reconstructed. Nonempty literal redactKeys opts into structural field filtering, including credential and URL/query keys; with redactSensitive:true Text and non-Dictionary top-level payloads stay redacted. Empty keys preserve default disclosure. Unsupported native/nested values have explicit statuses. Dates and labels remain opt-in. Native File acceptance is separate.

docs.title: Export QA Structured Trace Snapshot
docs.description: Combine the execution-local QA trace buffer into a deterministic JSON envelope for QA inspection or callback export without mutating __cherri_debug_log.

docs.title: Finish Debug Session
docs.description: Preview native objects with optional Creation Date names or display text with showLogsAsText.

docs.title: Debug Log
docs.description: Append previous native output without coercion. Optional withDates captures original Creation Date at source; showLogs previews native objects (with Set Name by Creation Date when enabled); showLogsAsText opts into Combine Text or dated text rows. A literal label stores separate scalar metadata and names preview copies; raw objects stay unchanged.

docs.title: Log Previous Result
docs.description: Alias for debugLog with optional withDates/showLogs/showLogsAsText and a literal per-entry label.

docs.title: Show Debug Logs
docs.description: Preview native objects, naming items by Creation Date when enabled; use showLogsAsText for text formatting.

docs.title: Start Debug Timer
docs.description: Remember the current time under a compile-time label.

docs.title: Stop Debug Timer
docs.description: Measure elapsed seconds and append the result to the execution-local log.

docs.title: Trace Value and Time
docs.description: Append current time followed by a value to the execution-local debug log.

docs.title: Record QA Structured Trace Event
docs.description: Append a structured JSONL trace record (stage, label, step sequence, and CurrentDate timestamp) to the execution-local QA trace buffer without mutating __cherri_debug_log.

docs.title: Measure Block
docs.description: Legacy and V2 scoped block with no block parameters. Evaluate the body exactly once in Debug and Release. A value body returns its original typed value; a Void body has no result and cannot be bound or consumed. The signature below illustrates the value form. Debug records elapsed seconds; Release preserves body effects without timer actions. A workflow-stopping action can prevent the final timer action from running; this is not a finally or cancellation guarantee. Runtime timing accuracy remains platform-dependent.

parameters.displayName: Selected native item kind (dictionary, text, number, bool)

docs.title: Paginate Bounded Dictionary Pages
docs.description: Traverse native Dictionary page bodies with ordered Dictionary items and a body next marker. Default URL mode accepts same-origin absolute URLs or simple sibling filenames. Optional cursor/page/offset modes use a fixed authored URL and replace one configured query value; cursor Text is encoded and roundtrip-checked, numeric next markers are exact bounded integers. Query byte order and unrelated query values remain unchanged. Exact marker and resolved-URL hash cycles, absent/empty next and literal caps stop traversal; either zero cap emits no GET. Optional headers use the native HTTP Dictionary codec with runtime leaf values. An optional { page in ... } body receives the immutable native page Dictionary once per validated page, preserves lexical captured writes and must be Void; either zero cap skips it. Optional itemKey selects a required Dictionary field and itemType determines List<Dictionary>, List<Text>, List<Number> or List<Bool> with native singleton/type guards. Values keep their original native reference. Number and Boolean modes fail before any GET when native Boolean and Number witnesses are indistinguishable. Empty/absent values and standalone nested Lists are not declared lossless result shapes. Link parsing, HTTP status verification, retry and transport timeout remain separate contracts. Native runtime acceptance remains required.

docs.title: Require Condition or Typed Value
docs.description: Require a source-proved Boolean condition, or validate text, number or dictionary native content and optional nonempty character/key/item count, then return the original value. Type and nonEmpty are compile-time literals.

requirements.name: Typed require
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Return the original typed object after semantic validation; failure stops with the supplied message.
limitations: Full false/zero/null/empty/native-object matrix and native failure/cancel proof are not established by this ledger.

requirements.name: debugLog labels
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Stable per-entry labels without replacing the original raw object or its downstream UUID.
externalPrerequisites: Native file/object identity and six-mode label acceptance
limitations: Per-entry metadata and bounded source contracts are implemented; signed File-carrier byte identity still requires repair and acceptance.

requirements.name: Local debugExport
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Local returned file; typed JSON/text or explicit opaque placeholders; safe escaping and default redaction.
limitations: Local export source preserves full default redaction. Explicit disclosure supports Text, native Number display text, ISO 8601 Dates and bounded Dictionary field diagnostics; nonempty literal redactKeys filters fields before value access. Source Bool/null/List boundaries, nested containers, native Date/label behavior and returned File acceptance remain open. Separate feature tests do not grant runtime credit to this ledger; QA debugExportTrace is separate.

requirements.name: Shared typed block facility
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Scoped typed block/IR, one evaluation, shadowing, value/void, nesting and explicit unavailable-dialect diagnostics.
limitations: V2 and Legacy share once-only typed-value and Void measure bodies with explicit empty-result boundaries. General parameterized blocks, control-result declarations and full early-error/cancellation semantics remain open.

requirements.name: Measure typed value
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Evaluate the body once, preserve its native result and remove only timing instrumentation in Release.
externalPrerequisites: Apple timing accuracy and error/cancel observation
limitations: Legacy uses a final yield or value-producing call through existing structured tokens. Structural UUID/timer checks are not native elapsed-time, abort or cancellation proof.

requirements.name: Typed collection
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Use existing native Repeat Results without a second accumulator or standalone alias; account separately for typed input construction.
externalPrerequisites: Native empty/mixed/nested collection shape and performance observation
limitations: No standalone collect alias is introduced. Compiled Repeat Results does not prove runtime flattening behavior.

requirements.name: Persistent TTL cache
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Explicit namespace/scope/TTL and honest serialization, invalidation, clock and permission behavior.
limitations: Shared source supports Text/Number/Bool and guarded Date epoch-offset archives. Dictionary/List/Optional/JsonNull/File persistence remains unsupported. This ledger does not exercise persistence, payload round trips, expiry, invalidation or native error behavior; invalid numeric Date archives may abort in native Adjust Date before reconstruction guards.

requirements.name: Bounded retry
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Bounded attempts/backoff with actual transport/status/permission/cancel classification and idempotence safeguards.
externalPrerequisites: Recoverable native error/status contract and signed synthetic endpoint probes
limitations: No evidence establishes catchable transport failures; Alert plus Stop Shortcut is not exception handling.

requirements.name: Bounded pagination
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Explicit limits/cursor termination, typed aggregation and malformed/error/rate-limit/credential safeguards.
limitations: The shared bounded GET implementation has page/item limits, cycle guards, page callbacks and literal Dictionary/Text/Number/Bool item selection with optional key projection. These ledger cases exercise the default Dictionary route only; separate typed-selection tests do not establish native list shape. Response headers/status, transport recovery, redirect limits and generic retry remain outside its proven contract.

requirements.name: Debug and Release
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Compile-time diagnostic removal while retaining semantic require checks and original native producers.
externalPrerequisites: Native result equivalence and debug-mode acceptance
limitations: The controlled compiler comparisons cover declared fixtures; they do not establish every diagnostic or runtime path.

requirements.name: Macro QA and consumers
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Generated evidence, canonical metadata/docs and coherent Skill/iOS/remote consumer acceptance.
externalPrerequisites: Final pinned consumer tuple and signed/physical acceptance evidence
limitations: This ledger builds and tests a compiler; it does not install a Skill, update a provider or execute on Apple.
